WITH regional_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    d.A3,
    COUNT(c.client_id) as client_count,
    COUNT(c.client_id) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(c.client_id)) OVER () as share
  FROM client c
  JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
  GROUP BY d.A3
),
avg_share_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM regional_shares
)
SELECT 
  SUM(rs.client_count) as total_clients,
  AVG(rs.share) as average_share,
  AVG(rs.share - asc.avg_share) as average_above_average
FROM regional_shares rs
CROSS JOIN avg_share_calc asc
WHERE rs.share > asc.avg_share

assumptions.assumption: The 'average share' refers to the arithmetic mean of all regional shares (1 / number of regions with clients)
